quest.title: Where the White Dove Rests
quest.description: Go to Silvermoon Hall, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Columbina...

talks.objective: Go to Silvermoon Hall to start the tea party
Go to Silvermoon Hall to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Wh—What? That's impossible!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Looks like you lost, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I... I let you win!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Really? Then why do you seem so worked up?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Darn it... I want a rematch!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, piece of cake.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You win. You really are quite skilled, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Let's play something more challenging next time. I know a lot of fun math-based games.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sounds exciting! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Huh? What's so funny?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I can barely remember seeing you this happy before. You hardly ever invited me to play games. Usually, you'd just chase me away.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey... Don't make me out to be some sort of bully! I'll invite you to more tea parties from now on, alright?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: I'd like that, Sandrone. I enjoy these little gatherings.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It's a lot of fun playing games. I look forward to doing it more often.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Leaving already? Alright, see you next time.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: We always used to gather in your garden, Sandrone. Now you're the one visiting me for tea. It's such an odd feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm still the one getting everything ready. Doesn't feel so different to me...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mmhmm, and your food is every bit as delicious as I remember.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: #Hmm... I hear {NICKNAME} visits you quite often. What do you usually do?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sometimes we chat, sometimes we play games with the kuuhenki, and we also like to watch them draw. Oh, and we play Moon Chess, too.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Moon Chess? Is that the one where you try to get three pieces in a row? Who usually wins?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: #I don't keep count, but I must say {NICKNAME}'s a very skilled player.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Heh, I'll show you what real skill looks like. Care for a game? If we draw, it counts as a win for you.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sure thing. Let's go!
